messages:
June Park: quick sync — fused-attn fastpaths and compatibility. Found deterministic divergence in dropout-free path when rope-offset != 0. Need decision on runtime contract.
Samir Rao: can you paste a minimal repro or config?
June Park: here's the simplified call from our harness:
```
fused_attn(qkv, bias=true, apply_rope=true, dropout=false, quant=INT8)
// kernel: fused_qkv_v3_fastpath
```
Maya Chen: if the dropout-free path bypasses any per-head scaling normalization we could diverge; rope is deterministic, so mismatch suggests different numeric reorder or quant scale.
Eli Brooks: observed mismatch only when quant=8bit + fused-bias enabled. Hypothesis: int8 kernel uses per-head asymmetric scale vs baseline symmetric scale.
June Park: perf numbers: fused fastpath = 2.8x tokens/s on A5000 in our bench, but we see ~0.6% perplexity regression on small eval set.
Thomas O'Leary: we need a clear runtime contract. Proposal: add model manifest flag `fused_compat: strict|relaxed|none`.
Samir Rao: +1. Also add staged rollout: canary -> compare eval delta -> auto-fallback if delta > threshold.
Maya Chen: note: ONNX-exported checkpoints that pack QKV dims together are an edge case. We should auto-detect `qkv_shape` and use a compatibility shim routing to legacy path if needed.
June Park: proposed plan:
1) add per-model manifest field `fused_compat`
2) add unit-test harness for exact-seed reproducibility
3) add runtime metric `fused_delta_ppl` and surface in Console
Any objections?
Eli Brooks: no objections. Will update eval harness and docs.
ci-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-tests/fused-paths -> canary at 2025-06-02 09:30 UTC
Thomas O'Leary: :thumbsup: I'll open a short RFC PR for the manifest field and rollout gating. assigning Samir + Maya for test harness.
Samir Rao: ack. I'll also add an ops runbook snippet for emergency fallback: `rd-service --set-kernel=legacy-attn`.
June Park: thanks — Samir, please also collect failing model examples and list them. put artifacts in the experiments bucket.
Samir Rao: ack — will share list + example artifacts by EOD.
